
name: "Project — Create Service Account & Manage IAM Bindings"
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      app_name:
        description: "Name of Application"
        required: true
        type: string
      team_name:
        description: "Name of Team"
        required: true
        type: string
      cost_center:
        description: "Cost Center"
        required: true
        type: string
      project_id:
        description: "GCP project ID where the service account will be created"
        required: true
        type: string
      service_account_name:
        description: "Service account name (lowercase, alphanumeric + hyphens; e.g. ml-pipeline-sa)"
        required: true
        type: string
      service_account_display_name:
        description: "Service account display name (human-readable; e.g. ML Pipeline Service Account)"
        required: true
        type: string
      roles:
        description: |
          Comma-separated roles to bind at project level
          (e.g. roles/viewer,roles/storage.objectAdmin)
        required: false
        type: string
      members:
        description: |
          Comma-separated members for the role bindings
          (e.g. user:email@example.com,serviceAccount:my-sa@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com)
        required: false
        type: string
      resource_type:
        description: "IAM binding resource type (project | folder | service_account | organization)"
        required: false
        type: choice
        options:
          - project
          - folder
          - service_account
          - organization
        default: project
      resource_id:
        description: |
          Resource ID to bind IAM on. Defaults to project_id when resource_type=project.
          For folder: folder numeric ID. For org: org numeric ID.
          For service_account: full SA email.
        required: false
        type: string
      environment:
        description: "Target environment"
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
          - non-prod
          - prod
        default: non-prod
      action:
        description: "Action to perform"
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
          - plan
          - apply
        default: plan

permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

# FIX #10: Added inputs.environment to concurrency group so non-prod and prod
# runs for the same SA name do not cancel each other.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ inputs.service_account_name }}-${{ inputs.environment }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  # ── 1. Print inputs ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  print-params:
    name: print input parameters
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: print inputs
        run: |
          SA_KEY="${{ inputs.service_account_name }}"
          SA_KEY="${SA_KEY//-/_}"
          SA_EMAIL="${{ inputs.service_account_name }}@${{ inputs.project_id }}.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
          RESOURCE_ID="${{ inputs.resource_id }}"
          if [ -z "${RESOURCE_ID}" ]; then RESOURCE_ID="${{ inputs.project_id }}"; fi
          echo "========================================================"
          echo "  CREATE SERVICE ACCOUNT & IAM BINDINGS — INPUT PARAMETERS"
          echo "========================================================"
          echo "  project_id              : ${{ inputs.project_id }}"
          echo "  service_account_name    : ${{ inputs.service_account_name }}"
          echo "  service_account_display : ${{ inputs.service_account_display_name }}"
          echo "  app_name                : ${{ inputs.app_name }}"
          echo "  team_name               : ${{ inputs.team_name }}"
          echo "  cost_center             : ${{ inputs.cost_center }}"
          echo "  roles                   : ${{ inputs.roles }}"
          echo "  members                 : ${{ inputs.members }}"
          echo "  resource_type           : ${{ inputs.resource_type }}"
          echo "  resource_id             : ${RESOURCE_ID}"
          echo "  environment             : ${{ inputs.environment }}"
          echo "  action                  : ${{ inputs.action }}"
          echo "  triggered by            : ${{ github.actor }}"
          echo "  run id                  : ${{ github.run_id }}"
          echo "  ref                     : ${{ github.ref }}"
          echo ""
          echo "  Derived Terraform key:"
          echo "    sa_key        : ${SA_KEY}"
          echo "  Computed email:"
          echo "    sa_email      : ${SA_EMAIL}"
          echo ""
          CENTRAL_BUCKET="h100-tf-state-np-0005"
          if [ "${{ inputs.environment }}" = "prod" ]; then CENTRAL_BUCKET="h100-tf-state-prod-0005"; fi
          echo "  State:"
          echo "    bucket : ${CENTRAL_BUCKET}  (project: h100-bootstrap-0005)"
          echo "    prefix : iam/${{ inputs.service_account_name }}"
          echo "========================================================"

  # ── 2. Terraform plan ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  plan:
    name: terraform plan — ${{ inputs.environment }} / ${{ inputs.service_account_name }}
    needs: print-params
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: ${{ inputs.environment }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
      pull-requests: write
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: environments/iam
    env:
      PROJECT_ID:    ${{ inputs.project_id }}
      SA_NAME:       ${{ inputs.service_account_name }}
      SA_DISPLAY:    ${{ inputs.service_account_display_name }}
      ENVIRONMENT:   ${{ inputs.environment }}
      ACTION:        ${{ inputs.action }}
      TEAM_NAME:     ${{ inputs.team_name }}
      APP_NAME:      ${{ inputs.app_name }}
      COST_CENTER:   ${{ inputs.cost_center }}
      ROLES:         ${{ inputs.roles }}
      MEMBERS:       ${{ inputs.members }}
      RESOURCE_TYPE: ${{ inputs.resource_type }}
      RESOURCE_ID:   ${{ inputs.resource_id }}
      TF_SA_EMAIL:   sa-kcc-org@h100-bootstrap-0005.iam.gserviceaccount.com
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: derive terraform key
        run: |
          SA_KEY="${SA_NAME//-/_}"
          echo "SA_KEY=${SA_KEY}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          EFFECTIVE_RESOURCE_ID="${RESOURCE_ID}"
          if [ -z "${EFFECTIVE_RESOURCE_ID}" ]; then EFFECTIVE_RESOURCE_ID="${PROJECT_ID}"; fi
          echo "EFFECTIVE_RESOURCE_ID=${EFFECTIVE_RESOURCE_ID}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - id: auth
        uses: google-github-actions/auth@v2
        with:
          workload_identity_provider: projects/145810318886/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/prism-github-actions-pool/providers/prism-github-actions-provider
          service_account: sa-github-prism-cd@h100-bootstrap-0005.iam.gserviceaccount.com

      - name: set auth to TF IAC SA
        run: |
          gcloud config set auth/impersonate_service_account ${TF_SA_EMAIL}
          echo "GOOGLE_IMPERSONATE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT=${TF_SA_EMAIL}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: resolve state bucket
        run: |
          if [ "${ENVIRONMENT}" = "prod" ]; then
            ACTIVE_STATE_BUCKET="h100-tf-state-prod-0005"
          else
            ACTIVE_STATE_BUCKET="h100-tf-state-np-0005"
          fi
          echo "State stored in central gs://${ACTIVE_STATE_BUCKET}"
          echo "ACTIVE_STATE_BUCKET=${ACTIVE_STATE_BUCKET}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3
        with:
          terraform_version: "1.14.9"

      - name: generate service account and IAM vars
        run: |
          python3 << 'PYEOF'
          import json, os, sys

          proj          = os.environ['PROJECT_ID']
          sa_name       = os.environ['SA_NAME']
          sa_display    = os.environ['SA_DISPLAY']
          sa_key        = os.environ['SA_KEY']
          team_name     = os.environ['TEAM_NAME'].lower().replace(' ', '-')
          app_name      = os.environ['APP_NAME'].lower().replace(' ', '-')
          cost_center   = os.environ['COST_CENTER'].lower().replace(' ', '-')
          env           = os.environ['ENVIRONMENT']
          roles_raw     = os.environ.get('ROLES', '')
          members_raw   = os.environ.get('MEMBERS', '')
          resource_type = os.environ.get('RESOURCE_TYPE', 'project')
          resource_id   = os.environ.get('EFFECTIVE_RESOURCE_ID', proj)

          sa_cfg = {
              "project":      proj,
              "account_id":   sa_name,
              "display_name": sa_display,
              "description":  f"Service account for {app_name} ({team_name})",
          }

          roles_list   = [r.strip() for r in roles_raw.split(',')   if r.strip()]
          members_list = [m.strip() for m in members_raw.split(',') if m.strip()]

          # FIX #7: Warn clearly when no IAM bindings will be created.
          if not roles_list or not members_list:
              print("WARNING: roles or members is empty — no IAM bindings will be created.", flush=True)

          iam_bindings = {}
          for role in roles_list:
              role_slug = role.replace('/', '').replace(':', '')
              for member in members_list:
                  member_slug = (member.replace(':', '').replace('@', '_at')
                                       .replace('.', '').replace('/', ''))
                  key = f"{sa_key}{role_slug}{member_slug}"
                  iam_bindings[key] = {
                      "role":          role,
                      "member":        member,
                      "resource_id":   resource_id,
                      "resource_type": resource_type,
                  }

          config = {
              "project_id":       proj,
              "service_accounts": {sa_key: sa_cfg},
              "iam_bindings":     iam_bindings,
              "labels": {
                  "app":         app_name,
                  "cost-center": cost_center,
                  "env":         env,
                  "managed-by":  "terraform",
                  "team":        team_name,
              },
          }

          with open('vars.auto.tfvars.json', 'w') as f:
              json.dump(config, f, indent=2)
          print(json.dumps(config, indent=2))
          PYEOF

      - name: terraform fmt
        run: terraform fmt -check -recursive
        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}

      - name: terraform init
        run: |
          terraform init \
            -backend-config="bucket=${ACTIVE_STATE_BUCKET}" \
            -backend-config="prefix=iam/${SA_NAME}"

      - name: terraform validate
        run: terraform validate

      - name: terraform plan
        id: plan
        run: |
          set +e
          terraform plan \
            -var="terraform_sa_email=${GOOGLE_IMPERSONATE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT}" \
            -out=tfplan \
            -no-color 2>&1 | tee plan_output.txt
          echo "exit_code=${PIPESTATUS[0]}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: fail on plan error
        if: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.exit_code != '0' }}
        run: exit ${{ steps.plan.outputs.exit_code }}

      # FIX #4: Publish plan output to the job summary so approvers can see
      # exactly what will be applied before they approve the gate.
      - name: post plan to job summary
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "## Terraform Plan — \${{ inputs.service_account_name }}\ / \${{ inputs.environment }}\" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo 'terraform' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          cat plan_output.txt >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo '' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

      # FIX #3: Upload the tfplan binary so the apply job uses the exact same
      # plan that was reviewed — preventing drift between plan and apply.
      - name: upload tfplan artifact
        if: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.exit_code == '0' && inputs.action == 'apply' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: tfplan-${{ inputs.service_account_name }}-${{ inputs.environment }}
          path: |
            environments/iam/tfplan
            environments/iam/vars.auto.tfvars.json
          retention-days: 1

  # ── 3. Apply approval gate ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  approve:
    name: approve apply — ${{ inputs.environment }} / ${{ inputs.service_account_name }}
    needs: plan
    if: ${{ inputs.action == 'apply' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: approve-gate
    steps:
      - name: apply approved
        run: |
          RESOURCE_ID="${{ inputs.resource_id }}"
          if [ -z "${RESOURCE_ID}" ]; then RESOURCE_ID="${{ inputs.project_id }}"; fi
          echo "========================================================"
          echo "  APPLY APPROVED"
          echo "========================================================"
          echo "  service_account_name    : ${{ inputs.service_account_name }}"
          echo "  service_account_display : ${{ inputs.service_account_display_name }}"
          echo "  project_id              : ${{ inputs.project_id }}"
          echo "  roles                   : ${{ inputs.roles }}"
          echo "  members                 : ${{ inputs.members }}"
          echo "  resource_type           : ${{ inputs.resource_type }}"
          echo "  resource_id             : ${RESOURCE_ID}"
          echo "  environment             : ${{ inputs.environment }}"
          echo "  approved by             : ${{ github.actor }}"
          echo "  run id                  : ${{ github.run_id }}"
          echo "========================================================"

  # ── 4. Terraform apply ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  apply:
    name: terraform apply — ${{ inputs.environment }} / ${{ inputs.service_account_name }}
    needs: approve
    if: ${{ inputs.action == 'apply' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: ${{ inputs.environment }}
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      pull-requests: write
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: environments/iam
    env:
      PROJECT_ID:    ${{ inputs.project_id }}
      SA_NAME:       ${{ inputs.service_account_name }}
      # FIX #1: SA_DISPLAY was missing from the apply job env block entirely,
      # causing a KeyError in the Python script and update-tfvars step.
      SA_DISPLAY:    ${{ inputs.service_account_display_name }}
      ENVIRONMENT:   ${{ inputs.environment }}
      TEAM_NAME:     ${{ inputs.team_name }}
      APP_NAME:      ${{ inputs.app_name }}
      COST_CENTER:   ${{ inputs.cost_center }}
      ROLES:         ${{ inputs.roles }}
      MEMBERS:       ${{ inputs.members }}
      RESOURCE_TYPE: ${{ inputs.resource_type }}
      RESOURCE_ID:   ${{ inputs.resource_id }}
      TF_SA_EMAIL:   sa-kcc-org@h100-bootstrap-0005.iam.gserviceaccount.com
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: derive terraform key
        run: |
          SA_KEY="${SA_NAME//-/_}"
          echo "SA_KEY=${SA_KEY}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          EFFECTIVE_RESOURCE_ID="${RESOURCE_ID}"
          if [ -z "${EFFECTIVE_RESOURCE_ID}" ]; then EFFECTIVE_RESOURCE_ID="${PROJECT_ID}"; fi
          echo "EFFECTIVE_RESOURCE_ID=${EFFECTIVE_RESOURCE_ID}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - id: auth
        uses: google-github-actions/auth@v2
        with:
          workload_identity_provider: projects/145810318886/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/prism-github-actions-pool/providers/prism-github-actions-provider
          service_account: sa-github-prism-cd@h100-bootstrap-0005.iam.gserviceaccount.com

      - name: set auth to TF IAC SA
        run: |
          gcloud config set auth/impersonate_service_account ${TF_SA_EMAIL}
          echo "GOOGLE_IMPERSONATE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT=${TF_SA_EMAIL}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: resolve state bucket
        run: |
          if [ "${ENVIRONMENT}" = "prod" ]; then
            ACTIVE_STATE_BUCKET="h100-tf-state-prod-0005"
          else
            ACTIVE_STATE_BUCKET="h100-tf-state-np-0005"
          fi
          echo "State stored in central gs://${ACTIVE_STATE_BUCKET}"
          echo "ACTIVE_STATE_BUCKET=${ACTIVE_STATE_BUCKET}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3
        with:
          terraform_version: "1.14.9"

      # FIX #3: Download the exact tfplan produced in the plan job so apply
      # executes the same changes that were reviewed and approved.
      - name: download tfplan artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: tfplan-${{ inputs.service_account_name }}-${{ inputs.environment }}
          path: environments/iam/

      - name: terraform init
        run: |
          terraform init \
            -backend-config="bucket=${ACTIVE_STATE_BUCKET}" \
            -backend-config="prefix=iam/${SA_NAME}"

      - name: import service account if exists
        run: |
          STATE_ID="module.iam.google_service_account.accounts[\"${SA_KEY}\"]"
          SA_EMAIL="${SA_NAME}@${PROJECT_ID}.iam.gserviceaccount.com"

          # FIX #8: Pass --impersonate-service-account explicitly so this check
          # does not silently succeed/fail if gcloud impersonation is not active.
          if gcloud iam service-accounts describe "${SA_EMAIL}" \
              --project="${PROJECT_ID}" \
              --impersonate-service-account="${TF_SA_EMAIL}" \
              >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            if terraform state show "${STATE_ID}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Service account ${SA_EMAIL} already in state — skipping import."
            else
              echo "Service account ${SA_EMAIL} exists in project — importing into state..."
              terraform import \
                -var="terraform_sa_email=${GOOGLE_IMPERSONATE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT}" \
                "${STATE_ID}" "projects/${PROJECT_ID}/serviceAccounts/${SA_EMAIL}"
            fi
          else
            echo "Service account ${SA_EMAIL} does not exist — Terraform will create it."
          fi

      # FIX #3: Apply the pre-approved plan binary directly; no -auto-approve
      # with a fresh plan — this guarantees apply matches what was reviewed.
      - name: terraform apply
        id: apply
        run: |
          set +e
          terraform apply \
            -var="terraform_sa_email=${GOOGLE_IMPERSONATE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT}" \
            -input=false \
            -no-color \
            tfplan 2>&1 | tee apply_output.txt
          echo "exit_code=${PIPESTATUS[0]}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: fail on apply error
        if: ${{ steps.apply.outputs.exit_code != '0' }}
        run: exit ${{ steps.apply.outputs.exit_code }}

      - name: summary
        run: |
          SA_EMAIL="${SA_NAME}@${PROJECT_ID}.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
          echo "========================================================"
          echo "  SERVICE ACCOUNT & IAM BINDINGS APPLIED SUCCESSFULLY"
          echo "========================================================"
          echo "  Service Account Email  : ${SA_EMAIL}"
          echo "  Service Account Name   : ${{ inputs.service_account_name }}"
          echo "  Project ID             : ${{ inputs.project_id }}"
          echo "  Roles                  : ${{ inputs.roles }}"
          echo "  Members                : ${{ inputs.members }}"
          echo "  Resource Type          : ${{ inputs.resource_type }}"
          echo "  Resource ID            : ${EFFECTIVE_RESOURCE_ID}"
          echo "========================================================"

          # Post apply output to job summary as well
          echo "## Terraform Apply — \${{ inputs.service_account_name }}\ / \${{ inputs.environment }}\" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo 'terraform' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          cat apply_output.txt >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo '' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

      - name: update terraform.tfvars
        run: |
          export TFVARS_PATH="${{ github.workspace }}/environments/${ENVIRONMENT}/terraform.tfvars"
          python3 << 'PYEOF'
          import os, re

          path          = os.environ['TFVARS_PATH']
          sa_key        = os.environ['SA_KEY']
          sa_name       = os.environ['SA_NAME']
          sa_display    = os.environ['SA_DISPLAY']
          proj          = os.environ['PROJECT_ID']
          team_name     = os.environ['TEAM_NAME'].lower().replace(' ', '-')
          app_name      = os.environ['APP_NAME'].lower().replace(' ', '-')
          roles_raw     = os.environ.get('ROLES', '')
          members_raw   = os.environ.get('MEMBERS', '')
          resource_type = os.environ.get('RESOURCE_TYPE', 'project')
          resource_id   = os.environ.get('EFFECTIVE_RESOURCE_ID', proj)

          # FIX #2: Handle missing terraform.tfvars gracefully on first run
          # instead of crashing with FileNotFoundError.
          if os.path.exists(path):
              content = open(path).read()
          else:
              print(f"  {path} not found — will create it.")
              content = ""

          roles_list   = [r.strip() for r in roles_raw.split(',')   if r.strip()]
          members_list = [m.strip() for m in members_raw.split(',') if m.strip()]

          sa_entry = (
              f'  {sa_key} = {{\n'
              f'    project      = "{proj}"\n'
              f'    account_id   = "{sa_name}"\n'
              f'    display_name = "{sa_display}"\n'
              f'    description  = "Service account for {app_name} ({team_name})"\n'
              f'  }}'
          )

          iam_entries = {}
          for role in roles_list:
              role_slug = role.replace('/', '').replace(':', '')
              for member in members_list:
                  member_slug = (member.replace(':', '').replace('@', '_at')
                                       .replace('.', '').replace('/', ''))
                  key = f"{sa_key}{role_slug}{member_slug}"
                  iam_entries[key] = (
                      f'  {key} = {{\n'
                      f'    role          = "{role}"\n'
                      f'    member        = "{member}"\n'
                      f'    resource_id   = "{resource_id}"\n'
                      f'    resource_type = "{resource_type}"\n'
                      f'  }}'
                  )

          def insert_into_map(content, map_name, new_entry, key):
              if re.search(rf'^\s+{re.escape(key)}\s*=', content, re.MULTILINE):
                  print(f'  {key} already in {map_name}')
                  return content
              single = re.compile(rf'^([ \t]{re.escape(map_name)}[ \t]=[ \t]\{{[ \t]\}})', re.MULTILINE)
              if single.search(content):
                  content = single.sub(f'{map_name} = {{\n{new_entry}\n}}', content)
                  print(f'  Added {key} to {map_name} (expanded empty map)')
                  return content
              if not re.search(rf'^\s*{re.escape(map_name)}\s*=\s*\{{', content, re.MULTILINE):
                  content = content.rstrip('\n') + f'\n\n{map_name} = {{\n{new_entry}\n}}\n'
                  print(f'  Added {key} to {map_name} (new map)')
                  return content
              lines = content.splitlines(keepends=True)
              in_map, depth = False, 0
              for i, line in enumerate(lines):
                  stripped = line.strip()
                  if not in_map:
                      if re.match(rf'\s*{re.escape(map_name)}\s*=\s*\{{', line):
                          in_map, depth = True, stripped.count('{') - stripped.count('}')
                  else:
                      depth += stripped.count('{') - stripped.count('}')
                      if depth == 0:
                          lines.insert(i, new_entry + '\n')
                          print(f'  Added {key} to {map_name}')
                          break
              return ''.join(lines)

          content = insert_into_map(content, 'service_accounts', sa_entry, sa_key)

          for key, entry in iam_entries.items():
              content = insert_into_map(content, 'iam_bindings', entry, key)

          # FIX #2: Ensure parent directory exists before writing
          os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
          open(path, 'w').write(content)
          print('terraform.tfvars updated.')
          PYEOF

          # FIX #6: Run fmt on the tfvars file after writing it so formatting
          # is consistent with what fmt -check verifies during plan.
          terraform fmt "${{ github.workspace }}/environments/${ENVIRONMENT}/terraform.tfvars"

      - name: commit and push terraform.tfvars
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          cd "${{ github.workspace }}"
          git config user.name  "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git remote set-url origin "https://x-access-token:${GITHUB_TOKEN}@github.com/${{ github.repository }}.git"
          git add "environments/${ENVIRONMENT}/terraform.tfvars"
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No changes — entries already present in terraform.tfvars."
          else
            git commit -m "[skip ci] add SA ${SA_NAME} and IAM bindings to ${ENVIRONMENT}/terraform.tfvars"
            MAX_RETRIES=3
            RETRY_COUNT=0
            while [ $RETRY_COUNT -lt $MAX_RETRIES ]; do
              # FIX #5: Use fetch + rebase against the remote branch instead of
              # a blind pull --rebase to avoid dirty-state issues on retry.
              git fetch origin
              if git rebase origin/${{ github.ref_name }} && git push; then
                echo "Pushed terraform.tfvars update."
                exit 0
              else
                RETRY_COUNT=$((RETRY_COUNT + 1))
                echo "Retry $RETRY_COUNT/$MAX_RETRIES: push failed, resetting and retrying..."
                git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null || true
                git reset --soft HEAD~1
                git stash
                git fetch origin
                git rebase origin/${{ github.ref_name }}
                git stash pop
                git add "environments/${ENVIRONMENT}/terraform.tfvars"
                git commit -m "[skip ci] add SA ${SA_NAME} and IAM bindings to ${ENVIRONMENT}/terraform.tfvars"
                sleep 5
              fi
            done
            echo "Failed to push after $MAX_RETRIES retries"
            exit 1
          fi
